correctness.rationale: The finite-dimensional map and inverse are explicit. For odd rings, splitting into constants and sum-zero coordinates yields one \(J_2(1)\) block and two coordinate rotations. For even rings, local factorization at each shift root, including the unit-root nilpotent calculation \((T+I)^2=AT\) and exact two-dimensional kernel, gives two regular shifts. Thus \(\dim\ker(F^t-I)\) = 2 gcd(n,t) minus one precisely when both are odd. Möbius inversion and odd-divisor separation prove the complete orbit population and pairing. The included direct matrix, independent exhaustive tuple dynamics, and integer Möbius programs passed 1,254, 66, and 682 checks respectively, with 87,360 binary states exhaustively enumerated; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
